youtube.title: 🔥 Build Voice Agents Without Paying API Bills
youtube.description: Every video call vendor charges two hundred dollars per month for voice API access. Hugging Face Speech-to-Speech runs voice-activity detection, speech-to-text, a language model, and text-to-speech locally through one WebSocket. It powers thousands of Reachy Mini robots in production and lets you swap any component with one command. Comment the word 'speech-to-speech' and I'll send you the link and tutorial for this repo.

linkedin.text:
Every startup I talk to is bleeding money on voice API subscriptions. 💸

Two hundred dollars a month per seat, per project, per environment — and that's before you scale. If you want a production-ready voice agent you're also paying for uptime guarantees, custom models, and support tiers that don't answer emails.

Hugging Face just released **Speech-to-Speech**, a fully local, fully modular voice pipeline. 🛠️

✅ VAD, STT, LLM, and TTS run on your own hardware  
✅ Every component is swappable — use Parakeet TDT for speech-to-text or swap it for Whisper with one flag  
✅ 7,074 stars and already powering thousands of Reachy Mini robots in production ⭐

No vendor lock-in. No per-call billing. No middleware that breaks when the provider changes their schema. You `pip install speech-to-speech`, run the server, and connect any OpenAI Realtime-compatible client.

If you're prototyping a voice assistant, building a robot, or trying to cut your infrastructure bill, this is the repo that gives you full control. 🚀

👉 Search GitHub for `huggingface/speech-to-speech` and try it yourself.

What's the biggest friction point you've hit with voice API providers?
